scope_definition: Public eligibility follows docs/catalogue-scope.md: national, state/provincial/territorial/autonomous/devolved legislatures with substantive legislative authority, plus their committees. Ordinary local councils and planning/service bodies are outside default scope; borderline authorities require explicit review. The wider historical discovery inventory is retained, with per-row eligibility assessments.
special_status_method: For related territories and free-associated or constituent countries, country is an audit grouping, not a sovereignty assertion. constitutional_relationship and scope_note qualify every special-status entry. This inventory remains incomplete.
special_status_remaining_work: Resolve current legal powers and broadcast services of the remaining territorial/council candidates; a searched inventory is not media validation.
Check Danish 2026/2027 region transition and current Philippine/BARMM and Indonesian special-region institutions; do not infer enactment or election from proposals.
Record neutral international status evidence for Kosovo, northern Cyprus and Transnistria before public promotion/mapping.
Close scope exceptions for uninhabited/administered UK/French/Australian territories, Oecusse/Atauro, Mount Athos and Canadian Indigenous self-government; no blanket completion claim.
Correct stale or unresolved institutional root domains and follow blocked pages in a normal browser; initial search results cannot settle absence of service.
surface_reconciliation_after_research: Promote useful validated official viewing sources to the canonical catalogue with identity, source conditions, accessibility and schedule evidence.

Ensure every promoted jurisdiction has correct shared country-search relationships, localized names, flag treatment and map geometry or an explicit representation. Nagasaki, Cordoba and Santa Catarina currently lack individual boundary shapes.
Reconcile catalogue, country/map source lists, schedule source coverage and shareable links from canonical data.

Only validated stable HLS enters IPTV playlists; only implemented and quality-checked programme parsing enters XMLTV. Record official viewing/archive/audio surfaces with appropriate capabilities rather than inventing media/guide availability.

catalogue_scope_decision.note: User clarified that deliberative councils, particularly ordinary city/town bodies, are not the intended scope. Names and parliamentary-style procedures alone do not determine eligibility.
